taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-07 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 2831.4 | 17.20 | 17.20
2 | 3567.9 | 2.07 | 19.27
3 | 3454.3 | 21.64 | 40.91
4 | 11701.4 | 4.12 | 45.03
5 | 140416.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-07
Curve type: QHA
Aquifer depth: 17.20 – 40.91 m
Recommendation: This interval corresponds to the comparatively lower-resistivity sequence (Layers 2–3) forming the "H" trough of the QHA curve, likely a weathered/fractured, water-bearing zone; the drilling team should target and case through this depth range for groundwater production, while noting the sharp resistivity increase below 40.91 m (Layers 4–5) indicates competent, largely dry bedrock where further penetration is unlikely to improve yield.
